entities.summary: Gregory Lawrence Parkes is an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. Parkes has been serving as the fifth bishop of the Diocese of St. Petersburg in Florida since 2017. He previously served as bishop of the Diocese of Pensacola-Tallahassee in Florida from 2012 to 2016.
